prose: Amazon's Strands Labs released Strands Decider 2B, a small decision model for fast experimentation and local development. Decision models, or 'system one' models, pick between sets of options rather than generating free text, a category that took off after TypeSafe's Jev launched earlier this month.
Examples include yes/no questions and choosing among categories.
highlights: Strands Decider 2B: small open decision model.
Picks among options; does not generate arbitrary text.
Follows Jev from TypeSafe two weeks ago.
